How it works

  1. 01

    Tell us what you need

    Lanes, equipment, position types, experience and record requirements, and how many seats are open.

Hire drivers

Find your company. Tell us what you need. Pick a time.

  1. Look up your company on FMCSA by USDOT number or name.
  2. Answer a few quick questions: fleet size, driver pay, trailers, escrow, truck year and the drivers you need.
  3. Choose a day and time for a 15-minute call. We come to it already knowing your fleet.
Hire Drivers

Carrier FAQ

When do we pay?

Only after a driver we sent starts driving for you. There is no retainer and no ad budget.

Who decides which drivers get hired?

You do. We screen to your requirements, and you approve every driver before they move forward.

What positions do you recruit for?

CDL-A company drivers, 1099 drivers, teams, lease to rent and lease to purchase, across dry van, reefer and open deck.

How do we get started?

Click Hire Drivers, find your company on FMCSA, answer a few questions about your fleet and pick a time for a 15-minute call. Before we start recruiting, we ask you to fill out our carrier questionnaire so we know your lanes, equipment and hiring rules.
